乾为天.name: Heaven
乾为天.text: Unbroken lines picture sustained creative effort. Initiative matters, but strength needs a sense of timing: beginning, growing, acting and stepping back are different tasks. Keep your purpose clear without treating persistence as permission to push through every limit.

坤为地.name: Earth
坤为地.text: Earth gives things room to take shape. This hexagram considers the work of receiving, supporting and carrying through. Following a sound direction can be an active choice; dependable care does not require taking the lead in everything.

水雷屯.name: First Growth
水雷屯.text: A beginning may contain both life and confusion. Before trying to advance quickly, find what can take root and who can help. Work on the conditions for growth rather than demanding a finished result from something still emerging.

山水蒙.name: Inexperience
山水蒙.text: Not knowing is a starting point for learning. Ask a clear question, listen carefully and put the answer to use before asking again. Guidance works best when curiosity is joined by a willingness to practice and accept correction.

水天需.name: Waiting
水天需.text: There are times when readiness and movement do not arrive together. Maintain the ordinary things that sustain you while watching the situation develop. Waiting need not mean neglecting preparation, and impatience need not decide when you act.

天水讼.name: Dispute
天水讼.text: Opposing positions can harden when each side keeps pressing its claim. Look for a fair way to clarify the disagreement before it consumes more than it can resolve. This is a reflection on conflict, not a prediction of a legal outcome.

地水师.name: Organized Effort
地水师.text: A group needs more than numbers to act together. Clear responsibilities, measured discipline and trustworthy leadership give shared effort a direction. Consider whether the people involved understand both the purpose and the limits of what they are being asked to do.

水地比.name: Seeking Common Ground
水地比.text: People come together around a center they can trust. Consider what binds a group, whether its commitments are clear and whether joining is freely chosen. Belonging is strengthened by honest participation rather than by agreement at any cost.

风天小畜.name: Small Restraint
风天小畜.text: A small influence can gather momentum without yet changing the whole situation. Attend to details, preserve what is useful and avoid forcing a larger breakthrough. Modest preparation may be the work available now, even when the aim is ambitious.

天泽履.name: Careful Steps
天泽履.text: The image places a person close to something powerful. Pay attention to conduct, boundaries and the effect of each step. Confidence can help, but it is most useful when paired with respect for the situation you are entering.

地天泰.name: Open Passage
地天泰.text: Different forces are able to meet and exchange. Use an open period to build cooperation and strengthen the arrangements that make it possible. Favorable conditions still need care; ease is a reason to act responsibly rather than assume nothing can change.

天地否.name: Blocked Passage
天地否.text: What should communicate is moving apart. Notice where effort no longer reaches its intended purpose, and protect the commitments you can still uphold. A pause in outward progress can be used to avoid empty activity and preserve clarity.

天火同人.name: Shared Purpose
天火同人.text: Cooperation becomes stronger when it reaches beyond a small circle. Look for a purpose people can discuss openly, while making room for real differences. A shared task does not require everyone to become alike, but it does require fair dealing.

火天大有.name: Great Possession
火天大有.text: Having much brings questions about how it is held and used. Resources, ability and recognition call for proportion and generosity. Consider what your position allows you to support, and how to remain attentive to others while things are going well.

地山谦.name: Modesty
地山谦.text: A mountain held within the earth suggests substance without display. Recognize what you can do while remaining willing to learn and share credit. Modesty is neither hiding your contribution nor making yourself smaller; it is keeping your place in proportion.

雷地豫.name: Readiness
雷地豫.text: Energy can gather when people feel a common rhythm. Turn enthusiasm into preparation, and make sure the excitement has something dependable beneath it. The useful question is how to organize willingness before momentum runs ahead of judgment.

泽雷随.name: Following
泽雷随.text: Following asks what deserves your attention and allegiance as conditions change. Listen and adapt without giving up your judgment. A relationship or direction is worth continuing when you can understand why you are taking part, rather than simply being carried along.

山风蛊.name: Repair
山风蛊.text: Something left unattended now asks for deliberate work. Trace how the difficulty developed, distinguish inherited habits from present needs and begin with what can actually be corrected. Repair is more useful than blame when it changes the conditions that allowed neglect to continue.

地泽临.name: Drawing Near
地泽临.text: An opportunity to approach or guide others brings responsibility. Be accessible, listen closely and keep expectations proportionate to what you can offer. A period of growing influence is temporary, so use it to establish care rather than dependence.

风地观.name: Looking Closely
风地观.text: Step back far enough to see the pattern, including the example you set for others. Observation asks for attention before judgment. Consider both what is visible and what your own position may prevent you from noticing.

火雷噬嗑.name: Biting Through
火雷噬嗑.text: An obstruction between two sides needs to be identified and addressed. Clear standards and proportionate action matter more than anger. First understand what is blocking communication or cooperation; force without that clarity can create another obstacle.

山火贲.name: Plain Adornment
山火贲.text: Form can make meaning easier to see, but it cannot replace substance. Consider where presentation helps and where it begins to distract. A simpler expression may reveal what elaborate decoration has been trying to carry.

山地剥.name: Falling Away
山地剥.text: The supporting structure is being worn down layer by layer. Notice what still holds and reduce demands on what is fragile. Preserving a sound foundation may matter more than defending every outer part of an arrangement.

地雷复.name: Returning
地雷复.text: A small beginning appears after withdrawal. Return to a useful practice or direction without demanding immediate transformation. Renewal can start with a modest, repeatable action that gives emerging energy a place to grow.

天雷无妄.name: Uncontrived Action
天雷无妄.text: Act from what is real rather than from an elaborate attempt to control every result. Clear intentions still need attention to circumstances. This hexagram invites straightforward conduct without promising that sincerity alone will make events follow your wishes.

山天大畜.name: Great Restraint
山天大畜.text: Strong capacity becomes more useful when it is trained and held with purpose. Gather knowledge, practice judgment and consider when to release your effort. Restraint can develop strength rather than merely prevent its expression.

山雷颐.name: Sustenance
山雷颐.text: Consider what you take in and what comes out through your words. Food, attention, habits and conversation all help form daily life. Ask whether the things you rely on are sustaining you and whether what you offer is useful to others.

泽风大过.name: Great Strain
泽风大过.text: The load has grown larger than the structure comfortably carries. Look at the balance between demands and support before adding more effort. An unusual situation may need a different arrangement, not simply more endurance from the same weak point.

坎为水.name: Repeated Depths
坎为水.text: Difficulty is encountered more than once, like water moving through successive hollows. Keep your attention on the next workable step and use familiar, reliable practices. Acknowledging uncertainty can support steadiness without pretending the challenge has disappeared.

离为火.name: Clear Light
离为火.text: Fire needs something to hold to, and clarity also depends on what sustains it. Examine the commitments, evidence and relationships that support your understanding. Brightness is most useful when it helps you see rather than merely draws attention.

泽山咸.name: Mutual Response
泽山咸.text: Influence moves through responsiveness rather than command. Listen for how each person's actions affect the other, and allow room for an answer that is freely given. Attraction or agreement is better understood through conduct than through pressure.

雷风恒.name: Continuing
雷风恒.text: Continuity comes from a purpose that can survive changes in method. Keep commitments that remain sound, while adjusting habits that no longer serve them. Endurance is more than repeating yesterday; it involves knowing what is worth carrying forward.

天山遁.name: Withdrawing
天山遁.text: Distance can be a deliberate response when engagement no longer serves a sound purpose. Set boundaries clearly and leave room to act later. Withdrawal need not be defeat; it can preserve attention and integrity without prolonging an unproductive struggle.

雷天大壮.name: Great Force
雷天大壮.text: Growing strength raises a question about restraint. Before acting, consider whether the means fit the purpose and whether others have room to respond. The ability to push does not by itself show that pushing is the right next step.

火地晋.name: Advancing
火地晋.text: Light rising above the earth suggests becoming visible. Make progress through clear work and dependable conduct rather than through display alone. Recognition is most useful when it helps the work continue and does not become its only purpose.

地火明夷.name: Light Under Cover
地火明夷.text: When open expression is difficult, protect the understanding you need without insisting on displaying it everywhere. Be attentive to context and choose where to speak. Quiet care can preserve something valuable during a period that does not welcome it.

风火家人.name: The Household
风火家人.text: A shared home depends on ordinary responsibilities being carried with care. Consider communication, boundaries and the example each person sets. The traditional household image can be read through mutual responsibility without imposing fixed roles on people today.

火泽睽.name: Divergence
火泽睽.text: People may look at the same situation from genuinely different directions. Work with the small points where cooperation is possible instead of demanding complete agreement. Understanding a difference can be useful even when it cannot be removed.

水山蹇.name: Obstruction
水山蹇.text: The direct route has become difficult. Pause to consider another approach, seek capable help and examine the part your own assumptions play. Changing direction can be a practical response to a real obstacle rather than a failure of resolve.

雷水解.name: Loosening
雷水解.text: A tension or blockage begins to release. Deal with what remains necessary and avoid keeping the difficulty alive through needless repetition. Relief creates space to restore ordinary cooperation and let people move beyond an old strain.

山泽损.name: Decreasing
山泽损.text: Reducing one thing can make room for something more necessary. Distinguish useful simplicity from deprivation, and consider who bears the reduction. A measured contribution is more sustainable when its purpose and limits are understood.

风雷益.name: Increasing
风雷益.text: Growth becomes more meaningful when benefit can move between people. Use additional room or support to improve what matters, rather than merely expand activity. Consider how a gain can strengthen the whole arrangement that makes it possible.

泽天夬.name: A Clear Decision
泽天夬.text: A problem that has been left vague now asks for a clear position. State the facts openly, prepare carefully and avoid turning firmness into hostility. Decisive action is more dependable when it includes awareness of its own limits.

天风姤.name: Encounter
天风姤.text: An unexpected influence enters the situation. Notice it without immediately giving it authority over your choices. An encounter can be significant while still requiring clear boundaries and time to understand what it brings.

泽地萃.name: Gathering
泽地萃.text: When people or resources gather, they need a clear center and reliable arrangements. Attend to why the group is coming together and how responsibilities are shared. A meeting becomes useful through care before, during and after the moment of assembly.

地风升.name: Rising
地风升.text: Steady growth works upward through small, supported steps. Seek guidance where needed and build on what has already taken hold. Progress need not be dramatic to be real, especially when each step makes the next one more manageable.

泽水困.name: Confinement
泽水困.text: Available room or support feels limited. Preserve what is essential, be honest about your capacity and choose where effort can still make a difference. Words alone may not change the situation; dependable action and appropriate help matter more.

水风井.name: The Well
水风井.text: A shared source can remain valuable through changes around it. Consider both the resource and the means by which people reach it. Something useful needs maintenance, access and care if its benefit is to extend beyond merely being there.

泽火革.name: Renewing
泽火革.text: An established arrangement may need substantial change. Clarify why, build understanding and consider whether the time and means are ready. Change gains support through a credible purpose and careful action, not through novelty alone.

火风鼎.name: The Cauldron
火风鼎.text: A vessel transforms separate ingredients into something that can nourish a group. Consider the structure, people and practices that hold your work together. Refinement involves both what goes in and whether the arrangement can carry what it produces.

震为雷.name: Stirring
震为雷.text: A sudden disturbance draws attention and unsettles familiar habits. Recover enough composure to continue the task in front of you. The image concerns how to respond to surprise, rather than predicting that a particular alarming event will occur.

艮为山.name: Stillness
艮为山.text: Stopping has value when it is done at the right place and time. Let attention rest on what is actually yours to do, without chasing every movement around you. Stillness can clarify boundaries and make later action more deliberate.

风山渐.name: Gradual Progress
风山渐.text: Some forms of growth need stages that cannot be skipped. Let trust, skill or belonging develop through repeated, dependable participation. A slower pace can be appropriate when the foundation must be established as you go.

雷泽归妹.name: Unequal Partnership
雷泽归妹.text: An arrangement may place one participant in a position with less choice or authority. Look carefully at expectations, consent and the limits of the role offered. The historical marriage image is a prompt to examine unequal terms, not a forecast about a relationship.

雷火丰.name: Full Light
雷火丰.text: A moment of abundance or visibility brings many things into view at once. Use that clarity while recognizing that fullness is a phase, not a permanent condition. Attend to what needs deciding without trying to keep every circumstance at its peak.

火山旅.name: The Traveler
火山旅.text: Away from familiar support, conduct and preparation matter in smaller ways. Respect local boundaries, carry what you need and avoid assuming a place is yours to direct. A temporary position can be navigated with care without being mistaken for a permanent home.

巽为风.name: Entering Gently
巽为风.text: A gentle influence can reach places that a single forceful gesture does not. Be consistent, communicate clearly and remain open to correction. Adaptability is useful when it keeps a purpose intact rather than dissolving every commitment.

兑为泽.name: Open Exchange
兑为泽.text: Conversation and shared enjoyment can make cooperation easier. Keep warmth joined to honesty, so that pleasing others does not replace saying what matters. Good exchange leaves room for both connection and independent judgment.

风水涣.name: Dispersing
风水涣.text: What has become rigid or divided begins to loosen. Look for a shared purpose that can bring people into contact again, without forcing old divisions to remain. Releasing an unhelpful attachment can make cooperation possible in a different form.

水泽节.name: Measured Limits
水泽节.text: Boundaries give a situation a workable shape. Set limits that are clear and sustainable, and revise those that become needlessly harsh. A useful measure supports continuing life and work rather than turning restraint into an end in itself.

风泽中孚.name: Inner Trust
风泽中孚.text: Trust grows when inward intention and outward conduct agree. Listen closely and make commitments you can keep. Sincerity is more persuasive through consistent action than through repeated claims about how sincere you are.

雷山小过.name: A Small Crossing
雷山小过.text: The situation favors careful attention to modest tasks. Keep your reach proportionate to the support available, and do not overlook small courtesies or practical details. Doing a limited thing well may be more appropriate than making a large gesture.

水火既济.name: After Completion
水火既济.text: The parts have reached a workable arrangement, yet the work of care continues. Notice early signs of imbalance and maintain what made completion possible. Finishing one stage does not remove the need for attention as circumstances keep changing.

火水未济.name: Before Completion
火水未济.text: The crossing is still underway. Distinguish what is ready from what remains unsettled, and keep attending to the final steps instead of assuming the result. An unfinished situation can hold possibility without requiring haste to close it.
